The '''Imperial Exploratory Division craft''' was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] before the outbreak of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
An [[Unidentified Imperial scout|Imperial scout]] used a craft of this type to explore under the auspices of the [[Galactic Empire Exploratory Division]]. During a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] accident, the scout discovered the lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seoul 5]].<ref name="SW84" />
